# tcpshield_analytics (Data Source)

Reads one analytics metric of a network. Needs advanced analytics (Premium or Enterprise) — without it the API answers `403 You do not have analytics access enabled.` The response shapes are not yet verified against the live API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_analytics" "users" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
  metric     = "uniqueUsers"
}

output "unique_users" {
  value = jsondecode(data.tcpshield_analytics.users.json).value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric` (String) One of `bounceRate`, `topDomains`, `uniqueUsers`, `retention`, `mitigatedCount`, `mcVersionBreakdown`.
- `network_id` (Number) Network to read analytics for.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The metric as normalised JSON — use `jsondecode()`; the shape differs per metric.
